lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay, let's start. Jordan, where are we on the billing service?

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: The migration is done in staging. I think we can deploy to production on Thursday morning.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: Thursday works for me, but I still need the API spec for the invoices endpoint.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Right. I will send you the API spec by Wednesday noon, that's a promise.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Great. I will review the design document on Tuesday and leave comments before the end of the day.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: One risk. The payment provider changes their webhook format on November eighth.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Good catch. I will add a compatibility layer so both formats work during the switch.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Perfect. Budget is tight, so let's not add new features before the launch.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: Agreed. I will also ask finance about the extra cloud credits we discussed.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thanks everyone. Same time tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I finally booked the trip. Lisbon, the second week of March.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: That sounds amazing. Which hotel did you pick?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: A small place near the Alfama district. I will text you the link if you want to join.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Yes, please send it. I will think about taking leave from the fifteenth to the twentieth.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: By the way, you mentioned your tooth was bothering you. See Doctor Okafor, she is excellent.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Thanks. I will call her office tomorrow morning and book an appointment.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Also, what are you getting your mom for her birthday?

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: I was thinking of a book about pottery, she has been wanting to take a class.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Lovely idea. Pair it with a voucher for a beginner workshop.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Oh, that's good. I will order the book tonight and look up workshops this weekend.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: And tonight, don't forget to send me that recipe for the lentil soup.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: I will send the lentil soup recipe this evening, I promise.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: Hello Jordan, this is Mister Brennan, calling about the apartment.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Hi Mister Brennan. Thanks for calling back. The bathroom ceiling is still leaking.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: Yes, I received your photos. I have booked a plumber to come on Friday at ten in the morning.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Friday at ten works. I will make sure I am home to let them in.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: Wonderful. Now, about your lease. It ends on December thirty first.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Right, I wanted to ask about renewing.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: I can offer a twelve month renewal, with a four percent rent increase.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Four percent is a bit more than I expected. Can I think about it and let you know?

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: Of course. I need your decision by November twentieth.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Understood. I will give you a final answer before November twentieth.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: Excellent. Also, rent for this month is still outstanding.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Sorry about that. I will transfer it tomorrow, first thing.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Dinner is ready everyone. Jordan, can you bring the salad?

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Sure, Mom. Smells fantastic.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: Your mother's birthday is on November fourteenth, and I want to take her to the lake cabin for the weekend.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: That's a great idea, Dad. I can drive you both on Saturday morning.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You don't need to fuss. But I would love to see the lake in autumn.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: Jordan, remember to call Grandma on Sunday. She has been asking about you.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: I will call Grandma this Sunday afternoon, I promise.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: We also need groceries. Eggs, olive oil, and oranges for the juice.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: I will pick those up on my way home from work tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: And bring an umbrella. They say it will rain all week.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Alright, let's eat before it gets cold.
